title: PHP 5.4.44 Released
content:
The PHP development team announces the immediate availability of PHP 5.4.44. 11 security-related issues were fixed in this release. All PHP 5.4 users are encouraged to upgrade to this version.

For source downloads of PHP 5.4.44 please visit our , Windows binaries can be found on . The list of changes is recorded in the . downloads pagewindows.php.net/download/ChangeLog

Please note that PHP 5.4 branch is nearing the end of its . Either September or October release, depending on discovered issues, will be the last official release of PHP 5.4. If your PHP installation is based on PHP 5.4, it may be a good time to start making the plans for the upgrade. support timeframe
